psychological_meaning: Silver is often associated with elegance, sophistication, and modernity. It can evoke feelings of grace, calmness, and sleekness. As a metallic color, silver also represents wealth, high-tech, and industrial strength, but in a more understated way than gold. It can also symbolize reflection, intuition, and wisdom.
